record.name: Airtable
record.one_liner: Airtable provides a remote MCP server and developer platform that enables AI tools to query data, create and edit records, manage schemas, and build automations using OAuth or Personal Access Tokens.

auth.notes: Supports OAuth (recommended for end-user connections) and Personal Access Tokens (PATs, recommended for CLI, scripts, and server-side setups).

access.notes: The MCP server and integration capabilities are available to all users on all plans, and developers can connect via OAuth or generate personal access tokens directly within their accounts.

api_surface.notes: Reported value was discarded: no support offered.

mcp.notes: Airtable provides a remote MCP server at https://mcp.airtable.com/mcp allowing AI tools to connect directly to bases.

buildability.reasoning: Credentials are self-serve (oauth2), but the pages do not establish the API surface, so integration work is harder to scope. (Derived from access, auth and api_surface.)
